role: Pure post-hoc elevation gain/loss computation from a buffer of raw CMAltimeter relative-altitude samples: 15-sample symmetric moving average then 2 m hysteresis over the smoothed series.
toplevel: Header comment documents algorithm and references; no top-level code.

units.does: Returns gain/loss for time-ordered barometric samples: if fewer samples than the smoother window returns zeros; otherwise smooths altitudes with movingAverage, feeds each smoothed level after the first into a HysteresisAccumulator (threshold default 2.0 m), commits the trailing run with finish(), and returns gain, loss and smoothed count. Timestamps are ignored (window is sample-count, not time).

branches.effect: false: returns Result(0,0,0) (workouts under ~15 s of barometer get 0 gain); true: continues
false only when samples is empty with smootherWindow <= 0 (no caller passes that): returns zeros; true: seeds the accumulator with the first smoothed level

branches.cond: for each smoothed level after the first
branches.effect: adds each to the hysteresis accumulator

flags.text: Smoothing window and hysteresis are defined in sample counts, not seconds, and timestamps are ignored. Callers feed it the CMAltimeter buffer (WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle.swift:178, WorkoutRecoveryService.swift:452) and also per-split GPS altitude from CLLocation fixes (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:466, window min(15, fixes.count)); any delivery rate other than 1 Hz changes the effective time constant the doc relies on.

units.does: Initialises the accumulator with the threshold and sets anchor, low and high to the start level; direction 0, gain/loss 0.

Updates running low/high with the new level and, depending on direction, turns a climb into a descent (or vice versa) once the level is threshold away from the run's extreme, or starts the first run once the level is threshold above the low / below the high.

branches.effect: turn(to:-1, at: level): commits the climb anchor→high and starts a descent from high
turn(to:1, at: level): commits the descent anchor→low and starts a climb from low
start(1, from: low): first run is a climb anchored at the lowest level seen
start(-1, from: high): first run is a descent anchored at the highest level seen
no state change beyond low/high update (sub-threshold wobble)

units.does: Commits the run in progress: adds high-anchor to gain when climbing, anchor-low to loss when descending; nothing when direction is 0.

branches.effect: gain += high - anchor; else no gain change
loss += anchor - low; else no loss change

units.does: Sets direction and anchor to the given extreme (first run start).
Commits the current run via finish(), re-anchors at the extreme just reached (high for a new descent, low for a new climb), sets the new direction and resets low/high to span level and anchor.

branches.effect: anchor = high (descent starts at the peak); else anchor = low (climb starts at the trough)

units.does: Centred moving average with the window clamped at the array ends (endpoint-preserving). Returns input unchanged when shorter than window or window <= 1. O(n·window).

branches.effect: false: returns values unsmoothed; true: smooths
